name: shotcut-mcp
description: Full transactional editor for Shotcut projects through a local MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Edit complete Shotcut timelines with transactional safety.
interface.longDescription: Local Shotcut and MLT integration for source-quality analysis, multitrack editing, clips, transitions, filters, markers, subtitles, previews, chapter files, backups, and monitored full or range rendering.
defaultPrompt: Check whether Shotcut is ready to use, then analyze this media for silence, black frames, freezes, interlacing, and loudness.
Show me how the current edit looks, summarize the timeline, and build or edit a complete Shotcut project from these media files with a preview.
Export one selected range for review and export this project's point markers as a Shotcut chapter file.
